title: Generated recipe eval dispatch needs a declared consumer ABI
body: The pinned kernel regeneration now emits materialStack/materialPresent and owns ReadPort, Instance, SampleSurface, MaterialRef, and Attach cases, but the existing VIXEN SdfRecipeEval consumer had no material-sidecar storage and still defined those cases by hand. Recovery added sidecar state, generated-case ownership, and diagnostics in the consumer. Consolidate the material-output/dispatch ABI so a generated contract supplies the required consumer seam without manual compatibility wiring. tier:luna; effort:M.

title: Box queue core and wrapper disagree on boolean elastic arguments
body: The required live queue failed during a queued build at the elastic command with box-queue-core exit 70: unexpected argument 'true' for --manual-active. The documented recovery was UT_QUEUE_JOBSERVER=0, which bypassed the optional jobserver/elastic boolean path and allowed the build and checks to pass. Keep the live wrapper/core contract synchronized or make the wrapper emit the flag syntax accepted by the installed core. tier:haiku; effort:S.
